description: This file defines the BlobOptionsConfiguration class which configures Azure Blob storage options for data protection in OrchardCore, including container and blob name setup with Fluid templating.

classes.name: BlobOptionsConfiguration
classes.description: Configures Azure Blob storage options for OrchardCore's data protection, including container and blob name setup with Fluid templating.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures BlobOptions by binding configuration and setting container and blob names.

methods.name: ConfigureContainerName
methods.description: Sets the container name for BlobOptions, rendering templates and ensuring lowercase, also creates container if needed.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobName
methods.description: Sets the blob name for BlobOptions, rendering templates based on ShellSettings.
